description: Source file implementing the IP Client Request Handler class for TR-069 host interface, managing IP interfaces, addresses, and related events.

classes.name: IPClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles TR-069 host interface requests related to IP interfaces, addresses, and events.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters and data structures.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Closes all IP interface related instances.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Handles get requests for IP interface, IPv4Address, IPv6Address, ActivePort, and related diagnostics.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Handles set requests for IP interface, IPv4Address, IPv6Address, and related diagnostics.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Retrieves notification enable status for IP interface objects.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Sets notification enable status for IP interface objects.

methods.name: getIPIfcIDs
methods.description: Retrieves interface indexes from system network directory.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks and triggers events for IP interface changes and updates.
